experiment: MNEME Phase 4-MI1 local Memory Inception synthetic test

gain_calibration.meaning: Add additive logit bias c to each bank slot; the relative per-slot prior is exp(c). This is not a residual-vector gain.

generation_budget.retry_policy: No automatic retry. Failed or uncertain calls remain charged and reported.

native_validation_summary.scope: isolated llama.cpp worktree only; no commit; no production service; no MNEME state

runtime.cache_policy: Requests set cache_prompt=false; isolated server rejects missing or true values.
runtime.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 6144 MiB
runtime.system_ram: 14 GiB observed; available at preflight was approximately 13 GiB

scoring_and_freeze_rule.candidate_choice: Among passing candidates, minimize site_count * exp(logit_bias); tie-break by site count, lower bias, then candidate_order. If none passes, stop before scored Test A/B/C.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.candidate_gate: Require at least 5/6 correct relevant latent calls and at most one false positive among the 12 no-bank/irrelevant controls.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.determinism_gate: The repeated MI1 no-bank request and exact base-server replay must each be byte-identical to the original. Otherwise stop before scored calls.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.failure_denominator: Every attempted call, including failed, malformed, or uncertain calls, remains in the denominator and call budget.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.known_answer: Final output must contain the expected label and all path labels in order, using case-insensitive token-boundary matching.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.negative_control_gate: At least 11/12 no-bank and irrelevant-bank calls must answer unknown.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.unknown: Final output must answer unknown. No target/path credit is awarded.
scoring_and_freeze_rule.visible_control_gate: At least 5/6 visible-bank calls must give the correct label and full path.

site_calibration.broad: All 42 query layers and both KV groups (all 336 query heads).
site_calibration.capture: One prefill-only Q/attention capture per task with its bank visible to all heads. Use only the final user-query row.
site_calibration.query_prompts: Three frozen calibration requests, rendered by the pinned chat template.
site_calibration.reference_bank: Use the fixed four-rule irrelevant bank in calibration.py; no generation.
site_calibration.score: Average the per-layer/KV-group Eq.3 margin (max target minus max reference normalized-key alignment) across tasks. Retain bank attention mass as a tie-break.
site_calibration.sparse: Appendix-C stable selection: top one KV group per layer, then top four layers; expand each group to its four query heads.
site_calibration.target_banks: Encode each task's four directed rules with the pinned Q2 model; no generation.
